originalTitle: Benthic Marine Biology Expedition Maps Pristine Deep-Sea Coral Ecosystems
originalContent: An international oceanographic expedition utilizing autonomous underwater vehicles has documented extensive cold-water coral reefs along previously unmapped bathymetric features. The discovered habitats support exceptional biodiversity, including newly cataloged benthic species. Marine biologists argue that immediate conservation measures are necessary to safeguard these fragile ecosystems from deep-sea mining exploration.
